channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-nextjs
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Reely — via awesome-nextjs
item.description: Movie & TV discovery and tracker on the TMDB API — live-applying filters, ⌘K command palette, watchlist and history, installable PWA. Next.js 16 static export on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets, so Next.js never runs in production. Demo

item.title: Lunidex — via awesome-nextjs
item.description: Open-source Pokémon workspace built with Next.js, featuring a Pokédex, TCG collection tracking, team building, battle tools, quizzes, and multilingual support.

item.title: FileFlex — via awesome-nextjs
item.description: Open-source, browser-only file converter & PDF editor built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and WASM.

item.title: DevScratchpad — via awesome-nextjs
item.description: Privacy-first developer scratchpad & utility suite (19+ tools) with Monaco editor and zero-server transmission. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, SSG), React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4. Demo
